KnightSight holds on to every note now, the ones on the pinboard as well as the ones you sent, until your assistant has them.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Pinned notes survive a closed KnightSight.** Each note goes to disk the moment you pin or edit it. After a crash, a restart or a sleep that KnightSight did not wake up from, the panel says how many notes from last time are waiting, and they are back on the pinboard as soon as you share the same window or region again.
- **Sent notes wait until your assistant confirms them.** A round stays on disk until the assistant says it has read it, so an answer lost on the way comes again. Rounds you send while the assistant cannot be reached wait in turn and arrive together, where a newer one used to replace the one before.
- **A busy port no longer looks like KnightSight is gone.** If another program holds the port the assistant talks to, KnightSight keeps trying until it is free. The assistant can now tell a KnightSight that runs but does not answer from one that is not running.
